name: Pre-Bosses
triggeredBy: Defeating Eye of Cthulhu or your world evil boss
description: You are still in the early exploration stretch where movement, ore upgrades, and your first reliable weapon matter more than specialization.
cues: You have not defeated any boss yet.
Your NPC roster is still early and the Dryad has not arrived.
Your gear is mostly ore, chest loot, and simple crafted upgrades.
blurb: Ore-tier gear and your first weapons, before any boss.

name: Pre-Skeletron
description: Your first boss kills have opened up better mobility, evil-biome materials, and stronger class identity, but the Dungeon is still gated.
cues: You have beaten at least one early boss such as Eye of Cthulhu or Eater of Worlds/Brain of Cthulhu.
The Dryad and Goblin Tinkerer can appear, unlocking better support gear.
You are preparing for Skeletron so you can enter the Dungeon safely.
blurb: Evil-biome gear on the way to Skeletron and the Dungeon.

name: Pre-Wall of Flesh
description: The Dungeon is open, underworld crafting becomes important, and you are preparing for the boss that flips the world into Hardmode.
cues: Skeletron is defeated and the Dungeon is part of your gear route.
You can craft milestone items like Night's Edge or class-specific Dungeon gear.
Hellstone, Obsidian, and Underworld farming are central to your upgrades.
blurb: Dungeon and Underworld gear, prepping for the Wall of Flesh.

name: Pre-Mech
description: Hardmode has started, new ores and souls are available, and your next goal is surviving the first major wall of Hardmode bosses.
cues: The Wall of Flesh is dead and your world has converted to Hardmode.
Altars can be smashed and Hardmode ores begin appearing.
Mechanical boss summons, Souls, and early Hardmode weapons define your grind.
blurb: Early Hardmode ores and gear before the mechanical bosses.

name: Pre-Plantera
description: The mech bosses are down, Hallowed-tier progression is online, and the Jungle becomes the next major gate.
cues: All three Mechanical Bosses have been defeated.
Hallowed Bars and Souls of Fright, Might, and Sight are part of your recipes.
Plantera Bulbs and Jungle survival are now your main progression focus.
blurb: Post-mech Hallowed gear, heading for Plantera.

name: Pre-Golem
description: Plantera has unlocked late-Jungle content, the Dungeon is upgraded, and you are collecting stronger gear before raiding the Temple.
cues: Plantera is defeated and the Jungle Temple key is available.
Post-Plantera Dungeon enemies and drops are now part of your progression.
You are gearing around Temple access, Chlorophyte-tier weapons, and event upgrades.
blurb: Post-Plantera gear before raiding the Jungle Temple.

name: Pre-Cultist
description: Golem is down, event farming peaks here, and you are polishing your build before opening the Lunar Events.
cues: Golem has been defeated and the Jungle Temple is no longer your blocker.
Pumpkin Moon, Frost Moon, Martian Madness, or Duke Fishron farming can all matter a lot here.
You are preparing for the Lunatic Cultist and the pillar sequence that follows.
blurb: Post-Golem gear and event drops before the Lunar Events.

name: Pre-Moon Lord
description: The Lunar Events are active, fragments are flowing in, and every upgrade is aimed at your Moon Lord attempt.
cues: The Lunatic Cultist is dead and the Celestial Pillars have started appearing.
Lunar Fragments and Ancient Manipulator crafting are available.
Your build decisions are centered around clearing pillars and surviving Moon Lord.
blurb: Lunar-fragment gear for the Moon Lord fight.

name: Endgame
triggeredBy: No further progression gate in vanilla v1
description: Moon Lord has fallen, so the focus shifts to best-in-slot cleanup, completion goals, and optional event or challenge farming.
cues: Moon Lord is defeated and the strongest vanilla drops are in reach.
You are chasing weapons like Zenith or polishing class loadouts instead of unlocking new progression tiers.
Remaining goals are optimization, events, building, or challenge runs.
blurb: Post-Moon Lord: the strongest vanilla gear.
